chapters.title: A usable path from API to paid result
chapters.label: STELLAR FORGE
captions: Stellar Discovery Trust Layer connects merchant APIs, explicit buyer decisions, and useful results.

chapters.title: Individual applicant · AI-assisted engineering
chapters.label: THE BUILDER
captions: Bryce Muhlnickel is the individual applicant and directs product priorities and relationships.
AI agents assist with design, implementation, review and engineering exercises. That assistance includes this presentation.

chapters.title: One operation, end to end
chapters.label: THE PRODUCT
captions: A merchant publishes an operation. The buyer inspects its exact terms, approves a purchase, and keeps the returned product.

chapters.title: Inspect the running merchant
chapters.label: ORIGINAL UI · LOCAL CONFIGURATION
captions: This is the maintained seller workspace, opened from the existing six-method merchant configuration.
Its documentation comes from the running service: methods, inputs, payment options and a reusable OpenAPI description.

chapters.title: Build the request and read the quote
chapters.label: ORIGINAL UI · UNPAID REQUEST
captions: Choose PATCH, supply the record and JSON body, then inspect the actual unpaid response.
The 402 response carries the concrete request and complete Stellar payment terms. This inspection creates no payment.

chapters.title: Review exactly what the buyer will request
chapters.label: ORIGINAL COMMERCE WORKSPACE
captions: The buyer workspace keeps the selected operation, recipient, asset, quoted amount and separate spending limit together.
Review uses the original buyer's immutable request. Payment approval remains in its configured operator flow.

chapters.title: Keep the request and its authority explicit
chapters.label: ORIGINAL COMMERCE WORKSPACE
captions: Method, body size, intent, operator and signer remain visible. Here the merchant is deliberately running in challenge-only mode.

chapters.title: Keep each intent's state
chapters.label: ORIGINAL DURABLE INBOX
captions: A different queued request can be cancelled explicitly. Its cancellation is retained in the original inbox.

chapters.title: Reopen the same workspace
chapters.label: ORIGINAL DURABLE INBOX
captions: After shutdown and reopening, the same cancellation remains. Reopening or refreshing the page does not purchase anything.

chapters.title: An actual native Stellar testnet purchase
chapters.label: RETAINED COMPLETED TRANSACTION
captions: The retained native PATCH purchase transferred 0.005 testnet XLM and updated the merchant record once.
The independent read-only check matched the authorized payer, recipient, exact amount and transfer event at ledger 5,142,311.
This completed run used an isolated local testnet policy. It did not exercise public ingress or the production workspace approval.

chapters.title: Keep the useful result
chapters.label: ORIGINAL SAVED MERCHANT RESPONSE
captions: The original response is 80 bytes of JSON: the updated record, its label and revision one.
The saved bytes match the recorded SHA-256. One approval, one signature and one merchant invocation produced this result.

chapters.title: What the proposed build adds
chapters.label: PROSPECTIVE SCF WORK
captions: The remaining build focuses on independent merchant deployments, operational response and a functional mainnet workflow.
The current proposal models 400 future hours, 38,000 dollars and 150 days. Completed engineering is excluded from those hours.
Measure attributable purchases, complete delivered results, recovery and repeat use, with testnet activity separated from commercial use.

chapters.title: Install, inspect, integrate
chapters.label: MAINTAINED OPEN SOURCE
captions: The source, operator guides and maintained distribution form one product. The next work is putting it to use with merchants.
